- **Desktop click-and-hold vs touch hold**: Kept direct full-screen opening for mouse click-and-hold on desktop. On desktop, hover previews already reveal full text when hovering over full-art cards, so keeping click-and-hold for the full-screen view preserves desktop functionality without loss of readability.
- **Direct modal sheet vs hover preview on touch**: Rejected falling back to `mode: "hover"` on touch holds for Mythics when `touchSheet` is active.
